'''Seylott''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Seylott (species)|Seylott]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was covered in dense [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and home to the [[Disciples of Shaa]].

==Description==
A tropical world covered in dense [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was home to the [[Seylott (species)|Seylott]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The wilds of the world were dotted with white stone temples hidden beneath the jungle canopy and crumbling from disuse.<ref name="JF" /> Vast canals crisscrossed the landscape, each one dug during the time of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==History==
An ancient world, Seylott was under the control of the Infinite Empire long before the rise of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While under [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] control the creature [[Gharj]] carved massive canals across the planet; the claw marks from Gharj's work could still be recognized by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Rakata eventually imprisoned Gharj in the [[Eternity Vault]], a massive prison on the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

The [[Disciples of Shaa]] were based out of the world's white stone temples deep in the forest, worshiping the two faces of [[Shaa]], the [[Mother of Shaa|Mother]] and [[Infant of Shaa|Infant]]. They believed that the stone monuments to the Mother and Infant were dangerous to move; the myths stated that the Infant would destroy the world if it were removed from its mother's embrace. During this time, the [[Annoo-dat]] political [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Ashaar Khorda]] learned of the Infant of Shaa's existence and began an effort to recover the ancient relic for use as a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. Although it was in his possession for a time, a [[Unidentified Seylott|Seylott devotee]] stole the idol in an attempt to preserve his [[Species/Legends|species]]' culture and hide their past crimes. The Infant was eventually returned to Khorda by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], and the Annoo-dat commenced his plans to use the idol to destroy the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Khorda and [[Ashaar Khorda's terror conspiracy|his associates]] nearly succeeded in destroying the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-world]], but failed due to the timely intervention of Jango Fett, his comrade [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]]. Before the Infant of Shaa could harm any of Khorda's targets, Poof disarmed it and gave it to Fett to return to Seylott. Placing the Infant back in its temple pleased the Seylott, as they believed that when the Mother and the Infant were separated, their world would decline further.<ref name="JF" />
